_comment: Advanced import validation hook - add to .claude/hooks/config.json
_usage: Merge this into your existing hooks config for more robust import checking

postToolUse.description: Validate import removal by checking actual usage
postToolUse.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "$OLD_STRING" ] && [ -n "$NEW_STRING" ]; then OLD_IMPORTS=$(echo "$OLD_STRING" | grep "^import" | sed "s/.*{\(.*\)}.*/\1/" | tr "," "\n" | tr -d " "); NEW_IMPORTS=$(echo "$NEW_STRING" | grep "^import" | sed "s/.*{\(.*\)}.*/\1/" | tr "," "\n" | tr -d " "); for import in $OLD_IMPORTS; do if ! echo "$NEW_IMPORTS" | grep -q "$import"; then if grep -q "$import" "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; then echo "❌ IMPORT STILL USED: $import found in file after removal"; echo "File: $FILE_PATH"; exit 1; fi; fi; done; fi'

postToolUse.description: Check for unused imports after edits
postToolUse.command: bash -c 'if command -v eslint &> /dev/null; then eslint "$FILE_PATH" --quiet 2>&1 | grep "is defined but never used" || echo "✅ No unused import warnings"; fi'
